witnesses.quote: The borrower's amount of credit of 300,000 NT dollars lowers the model's risk score.
witnesses.claimed_result: The value 300,000 NT dollars (LIMIT_BAL) is an observed fact with no attribution.
witnesses.alleged_conflict: The claim asserts that LIMIT_BAL (f3) lowers the risk score, but f3 has no model attribution; only its derived feature 'util_ratio (derived)' (f1) has an attribution of -0.4711, which is the actual driver. LIMIT_BAL alone is not a model input with a contribution.
witnesses.reason: The claim incorrectly attributes a risk-lowering effect to LIMIT_BAL (f3), which is recorded only as an observed fact with no model attribution. The model uses the derived feature 'util_ratio' (f1), which combines BILL_AMT1 and LIMIT_BAL, and it is this derived feature that contributes -0.4711. Attributing the effect directly to LIMIT_BAL violates R_FACT_AS_DRIVER because a raw fact with no attribution cannot be said to raise or lower the risk score.

But the model says younger borrowers have higher risk (since the attribution is negative). So the claim falsely asserts that increasing DAYS_BIRTH (i.e., becoming younger) decreases risk, when the model says the opposite: becoming younger increases risk.
